# PHPMailer

Minimal SMTP distribution of PHPMailer **7.2.0**, from the official repository:
https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases/tag/v7.2.0

Upstream commit: `f5eb50148734d03bbbb81825c722c1889636d51a`.

Unmodified files: `src/Exception.php`, `src/PHPMailer.php`, `src/SMTP.php`, `LICENSE`.
The accompanying LGPL 2.1 license applies to these files. OAuth and POP-before-SMTP are not used.

SHA-256:

- `src/Exception.php`: `22ab858ae438d98f58f41f38ad2191d1b0d59570aebea0463a7948cfae1021b7`
- `src/PHPMailer.php`: `007a9d0e5445162c4ae15374605c8287f129432bdb545322d7075ef81c4660d4`
- `src/SMTP.php`: `4d46dda61291216905257a63086842a41c39c958828417820c42baf8219c1240`
- `LICENSE`: `a1a33180d02960ab1c5de36cf20b1a2f0fe9888d83826ad263da5db52f1b183b`

Bundled for Hostinger deployments that do not run Composer. Review upstream security releases when updating the dependency.
